The immediate-adjacency constraints force three blocks: Finn right after Ben, Ann right after Elif, and Ivo right after Hana. Exactly one person between Gus and Hana, together with Gus before Ivo, places Gus two slots before Hana, so the local pattern is Gus, someone, Hana, Ivo.

Ivo before Ann forces Hana before Elif. The three-slot gaps among Elif, Ann, Hana, and Ivo then force Elif at least four slots after Hana. Hana can therefore only sit in slot 3 or 4. Slot 4 leaves no legal place for Dev (who must sit after Hana and before Finn). Slot 3 with Elif–Ann in 7–8 leaves Dev after Finn. The only remaining placement is:

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Gus","2":"Cara","3":"Hana","4":"Ivo","5":"Dev","6":"Ben","7":"Finn","8":"Elif","9":"Ann"}
CONFIDENCE: 99
